Budget management depth is required — candidate must be able to track weekly actuals, manage committed spend (POs, signed contracts), maintain a rolling forecast, calculate Estimate at Completion (EAC), explain variance, and present a complete financial picture to leadership with root cause and corrective action
Full working knowledge of SOW types and contract models — Fixed Fee SOW (vendor carries risk, scope must be fully defined), Time & Materials SOW (client pays actuals, requires tight burn rate governance), and Cost Plus SOW (actuals + agreed margin); must know when each applies, how to govern it, and how to protect the program from overrun under each model
Leadership bar — this role is expected to raise the standard for everyone around them; the right candidate will push engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders to deliver at a higher level, hold people accountable without micromanaging, and create a culture where the team does not need to be chased for updates
Fully onsite 5 days a week in Parsippany, NJ — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the program requires in-person leadership presence, real-time stakeholder engagement, and direct team visibility; remote or hybrid arrangements will not be considered for this role

Roles & Responsibilities

Own full accountability for project delivery across scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk — from project initiation through delivery, go-live, and stabilization; the project's success or failure is this role's responsibility
Define the project roadmap and integrated delivery plan at the outset — break the project into logical phases or waves, identify the critical path, map all workstream dependencies, and establish milestones that stakeholders can hold the team to
Establish and operate project governance from day one — steering committee cadence, RAID log, change control board, decision log, and status reporting framework; governance must be operational before delivery teams begin work, not retrofitted after problems appear
Manage vendor and partner delivery organizations — own the SOW and contractual obligations, run regular governance reviews, enforce SLA commitments, escalate vendor performance issues through the right channels, and document all delivery decisions
Drive cross-functional workstream alignment — chair dependency resolution sessions, maintain the integrated dependency log, assign ownership to every cross-team dependency, and track resolution to closure before it becomes a blocker
Own project financial management — track T&M actuals and forecast weekly, manage change requests through formal scope change process with full impact assessment on budget, schedule, and risk, and present financial health to SLT with transparency
Facilitate and own Agile project ceremonies where applicable — PI Planning, System Demos, Inspect and Adapt workshops — ensuring all teams have clear objectives, dependencies mapped, and capacity planned for each increment
Proactively manage the RAID log — identify risks before they become issues, assign owners, review mitigation progress weekly, and escalate items that exceed the project's risk tolerance with clear options and a recommended course of action
Lead change management activities — assess the organizational impact of the project, build a stakeholder communication plan, ensure business readiness activities (training, process change, cutover preparation) are tracked as project deliverables not afterthoughts
Be the single accountable point of contact for project health — provide weekly written status reports and participate in steering committee meetings with an honest, metric-backed view of progress, risks, and decisions needed; never present a rosier picture than reality supports

jobs.title: Project Manager/Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Description

Tyler Technologies Federal Team is seeking an experienced and motivated Project Manager / Scrum Master to support the delivery, enhancement, operation, and maintenance of mission-critical systems for the Library of Congress.

The successful candidate will combine disciplined project management with a practical, collaborative approach to Agile delivery. This individual will manage project commitments, facilitate Agile teams, coordinate with federal stakeholders, address delivery obstacles, and help drive work toward successful completion.

The position requires strong project management, communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, along with familiarity with business analysis and software development practices. The Project Manager / Scrum Master will work closely with clients, company leadership, Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, quality assurance personnel, DevSecOps engineers, security specialists, operations teams, and subcontractors.

Experience managing federal IT contracts, production systems, and Agile software development projects is strongly preferred.

Responsibilities

Manage project scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, assumptions, and delivery commitments.
Develop and maintain project management artifacts, including integrated schedules, risk and issue registers, decision logs, status reports, action-item logs, release plans, and other contractual deliverables.
Monitor project performance and communicate schedule, scope, quality, staffing, and financial concerns to company and client leadership.
Coordinate work across development, architecture, quality assurance, DevSecOps, security, operations, subcontractor, and federal stakeholder teams.
Identify variances from approved plans and lead the development of corrective actions and recovery plans.
Manage changes in accordance with contractual and organizational change-control procedures.
Support the management of multiple concurrent enhancement, maintenance, and modernization efforts.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum of five years of experience managing software development, modernization, operations and maintenance, or other IT projects involving teams of five or more individuals.
Demonstrated experience using Agile project management methodologies and supporting cross-functional software delivery teams.
Experience managing project schedules, risks, issues, dependencies, changes, deliverables, and stakeholder communications.
Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle, quality assurance, DevSecOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery, release management, and production support.
Experience using Jira, Confluence, or comparable project management and collaboration tools.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to pass a thorough background screening.

Additional Duties

Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, backlog refinement, Sprint Reviews, Sprint Retrospectives, and other team working sessions.
Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, federal stakeholders, and technical teams to develop and maintain clear user stories, acceptance criteria, priorities, and delivery goals.
Identify, track, escalate, and help resolve impediments affecting project or team delivery.
Promote team alignment, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Use appropriate Agile delivery measures to support forecasting, identify trends, and improve team performance and delivery predictability.
Facilitate requirements-gathering sessions, stakeholder interviews, workflow discussions, and project-planning meetings.
Ensure project requirements, decisions, action items, changes, and acceptance outcomes are documented and communicated.
Translate technical information for business stakeholders and communicate business needs clearly to technical team members.
Coordinate release planning and production-readiness activities across development, quality assurance, DevSecOps, security, operations, and client stakeholders.
Confirm that testing, approvals, documentation, communications, deployment plans, and rollback procedures are completed before production releases.
Participate in occasional evening or weekend deployments, maintenance activities, and production-support events.
Work with development and quality assurance teams to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are understood, testable, and aligned with project objectives.
Support user acceptance testing, release verification, training, operational transition, and knowledge-transfer activities as needed.
Coordinate project activities supporting the Risk Management Framework, Authority to Operate processes, security assessments, remediation efforts, and continuous monitoring.
Track security, accessibility, privacy, and compliance-related dependencies and corrective actions in coordination with the appropriate subject-matter experts.
Ensure project, requirements, release, testing, and operational documentation is complete, current, appropriately reviewed, and traceable.
Drive project issues and decisions to resolution and escalate concerns when necessary.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Preferred Qualifications And Skills

Experience supporting federal agencies, federal IT contracts, task orders, government project managers, or Contracting Officer’s Representatives.
Experience supporting the Library of Congress, U.S. Copyright Office, another legislative-branch organization, or a comparable federal customer.
Experience managing public-facing digital services, electronic filing systems, case-management systems, document-management systems, workflow applications, or other mission-critical software.
Experience supporting production applications with service-level agreements, maintenance windows, incident-management processes, and formal release controls.
Familiarity with cloud-hosted applications, APIs, identity-management services, payment integrations, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery tools.
Familiarity with FISMA, NIST security controls, the Risk Management Framework, Authority to Operate activities, and federal continuous-monitoring requirements.
Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines.
Strong leadership, organizational, prioritization, analytical, risk-management, and decision-making skills.
Strong business-analysis skills and the ability to assist with requirements, workflows, user stories, and acceptance criteria when needed.
Ability to manage multiple priorities accurately and independently in a collaborative, delivery-focused environment.
Ability to establish productive working relationships with clients, team members, company leadership, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
Ability to navigate changing priorities, competing stakeholder needs, and complex project dependencies.
Ability to identify and recommend improvements to delivery processes, team practices, and operational efficiency.
Self-motivated and able to work effectively with minimal supervision.
Relevant professional certifications are preferred, such as Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, Project Management Professional, PMI Agile Certified Practitioner, or SAFe Scrum Master.
Some work-related travel may be required.

jobs.description:
Position: Substation Project Manager
Fully Remote
Pay Rate: $60-$80 Hourly Based on Experience
Looking to HIRE RIGHT AWAY!!

Must Haves:

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering is preferred.
5+ years' experience in Substation design and engineering of High Voltage substation projects is highly preferred.

Plusses:

Project Engineering and/or Project Management experience with a strong bias for action.
PMP and/or P.E. in related discipline is a plus.

Day to Day:
Insight Global is
looking a substation engineer that is responsible managing all assigned substation projects from early-stage development through construction and commissioning, this role partners closely with the Early-Stage Project Manager and Development Group to define engineering scope and requirements. The position provides technical oversight, due diligence, and training for external Engineers of Record (EORs), ensuring full compliance with interconnection agreements, project specifications, site-specific requirements, and industry standards such as IEEE, NESC, and ASCE. It involves sourcing and managing engineering consultants through the Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), including developing scopes of work, securing bids, and awarding contracts, while also coordinating with stakeholders to secure sites, permits, and required data for successful project execution. The role supports competitive sourcing of geotechnical, survey, engineering, and construction services, collaborates with estimating teams on scope assumptions, and manages long-lead material orders to mitigate cost and schedule risks. Additionally, it ensures alignment with transmission requirements through review of interconnection studies and agreements, maintains regular communication with transmission owners/ISOs, and represents Engineering & Construction (E&C) interests through project updates, risk mitigation, and stakeholder presentations. The position also contributes to estimating improvements, supports commissioning activities, assists with regulatory and legal processes, and works with OEM partners to enhance designs in alignment with company standards, all while ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, and cost-effectively.

jobs.title: Intermediate Screening and Vetting Analyst (Intelligence Analyst 3) - 30004
jobs.description:
Requisition Number: 30004

Required Travel: 0 - 10%

Employment Type: Full Time/Salaried/Exempt

Anticipated Salary Range: $96,132.00 - $131,000.00

Security Clearance: TS/SCI

Level of Experience: Mid HI

This opportunity resides with All-Domain Operations (ADO)
, a business group within HII’s Mission Technologies division. All-Domain Operations comprises multi-domain operations, platforms and logistics, and intelligence operations.

HII designs, develops, integrates and manages the sensors, systems and other assets necessary to support integrated ISR operations and accelerated decision-making. With data fusion and mission management capabilities for the Department of Defense, the combatant commands and the intelligence community, HII advances the mission around the globe.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Who We Are

HII-Mission Technologies is seeking a Intermediate Screening and Vetting Analyst to support the Office of National Security (ONS) within the Immediate Office of the Secretary at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). ONS manages Department-wide programs and provides oversight, policy direction, standards, and performance assessments in the areas of counterintelligence, intelligence, insider threat, cyber threat intelligence, information security, national personnel security, homeland security, and the safeguarding of classified information.

ONS provides counterintelligence, intelligence, and security support to HHS Operating Divisions, Staff Divisions, and Department leadership. This position will support the Identity Intelligence Division (I2D) and focus on conducting screening, vetting, identity resolution, and risk analysis of foreign nationals, entities, and individuals associated with HHS programs, facilities, grants, contracts, acquisitions, and SBIR/STTR initiatives. The analyst will leverage government, commercial, and open-source information to identify foreign affiliations, indicators of malign foreign influence, counterintelligence concerns, technology transfer risks, and other threats to HHS-funded research, public health programs, and critical supply chains.

What You Will Do

The Screening and Vetting Analyst will conduct all-source intelligence analysis, screening and vetting, identity resolution, network analysis, and risk assessments to identify foreign affiliations, malign foreign influence, counterintelligence concerns, technology transfer risks, and other threats to HHS programs, research, and supply chains. The analyst will produce tailored intelligence products, provide briefings and decision-support to HHS leadership, acquisition officials, program managers, and security personnel, and develop working relationships with key stakeholders to address evolving intelligence and security requirements. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat; experience with analytical, investigative, or link-analysis tools

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. About The Role

Peraton is currently hiring a Jr Industrial Control System Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
for its Federal Strategic Cyber programs.

Location: On-site in Arlington, VA.

About the Role:

As a Jr Industrial Control System Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will play a vital role in safeguarding critical infrastructure by integrating multiple intelligence sources to create actionable insights and recommendations. You will support operational teams and senior leaders by investigating and analyzing cyber threats specific to operational technology environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Fuse multiple intelligence sources to develop comprehensive products, recommendations, and prioritize organizational focus.
Research and investigate current threats in operational technology (OT), critical infrastructure sectors, and mission areas.
Analyze data to derive insights on adversary capabilities, intentions, tactics, and behaviors in relation to critical infrastructure attacks.
Research and review cyber warfare tactics, techniques, and procedures affecting information networks.
Prepare assessments and threat profiles related to ICS/SCADA systems based on recent trends.
Escalate new or high-priority threats to the Cyber Physical Forensics Section as needed.
Investigate OT defensive tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) for threat detection and response.
Map ICS activities and threats using the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.
Collaborate with host, network, and cloud forensic analysts to support incident response and threat hunting missions.
Identify potential open-source vulnerabilities within ICS/SCADA environments.
Assess emerging threats and vulnerabilities related to homeland security.
Analyze classified threat intelligence reports concerning ICS/SCADA to evaluate adversary intent and capability.
Produce high-quality papers, presentations, and recommendations for senior US government intelligence and operations officials.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications: LU

Bachelor's degree and 2 years of experience, or Associate's degree and 4 years, or High School diploma and 6+ years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree.
Hands-on experience in processing, triage, threat analysis, and responding to cyber incident reports.
Demonstrated ability to research and analyze cyber threats across multiple industries or timeframes, including critical infrastructure sectors.
Familiarity with cyber threat intelligence tools such as DomainTools, VirusTotal, SHODAN, etc..
Proven experience producing all-source (unclassified and classified) finished intelligence assessments aligned with ICD203 analytic tradecraft standards.
Demonstrated strong collaboration skills and ability to build key threat intelligence partnerships to enhance information sharing and cyber defenses.
U.S. citizenship is required.
Active Top Secret Security Clearance with SCI eligibility.
Ability to obtain and maintain DHS EOD agency clearance prior to start.

SANS Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP).
SANS GIAC Response and Industrial Defense (GRID).
SANS GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI).

new_jobs.description:
Description

About EBR Systems

At EBR Systems, we're not imagining the future of cardiac care. We're building it. We are the team behind the world's first FDA-approved leadless left ventricular endocardial pacing device for heart failure. It's a breakthrough that's redefining what's possible, and it's just the beginning.

Based in Silicon Valley, we're advancing the WiSE System, a first-of-its-kind device in cardiac rhythm management. Your work here has a direct line to patients whose lives depend on what we build. We hire people who want to solve hard problems and who care about getting it right.

We invest in our people as much as our technology. Expect a collaborative, transparent culture, real career growth in a fast-moving startup, competitive compensation, equity, comprehensive benefits, and generous PTO.

If you want your work to matter, EBR is where you belong.

Summary Of The Position

The Training Program Manager owns the processes, systems, and documentation standards that make training and competency management for the WiSE System therapy consistent, auditable, and scalable across both the field/commercial organization and physician education programs. This role is a recognized subject matter expert in training operations — driving continuous process improvement, administering the Learning Management System (LMS), standardizing certification and competency documentation, and ensuring training records meet quality system and regulatory requirements. The Training Program Manager partners closely with Training & Education leadership on field and physician program design, scheduling, vendor management, and reporting.

While this role is primarily focused on training operations, process design, and administration rather than direct field delivery, EBR Systems highly values candidates with clinical or technical experience in cardiac device therapy (e.g., Cardiac Rhythm Management, Electrophysiology, or Structural Heart). A clinical background enables the Training Program Manager to build more accurate, credible training content and to better evaluate the effectiveness of field and physician training programs.

Essential Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL AND OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITITES:

Drive Training Process Improvement & Documentation Standards: Continuously evaluate and standardize training and competency-management processes — including curriculum development, certification pathways, and documentation practices — ensuring training records for the WiSE System program are consistent, audit-ready, and aligned with quality system requirements across field and physician programs.
Administer Training Systems & LMS: Own day-to-day administration of the Learning Management System (LMS) and other training systems, including course building, enrollment tracking, completion reporting, and troubleshooting, to support scalable digital and blended learning.
Manage Training Vendor & Program Operations: Own the training budget, calendar, and vendor relationships — including venues, faculty honoraria, simulation labs, and LMS platforms — ensuring high-quality, cost-effective delivery partners across both field and physician training operations.
Coordinate Physician Education & Proctoring Program Logistics: Plan and coordinate the scheduling, documentation, and logistics for physician training, case observation, and proctoring programs, including hands-on labs and structured educational sessions. Coordinate with key opinion leaders (KOLs) to support physician-to-physician education programs.
Develop & Maintain Training Materials and Certification Pathways: Contribute to the design, development, and continuous enhancement of training materials, curricula, and certification pathways that support the WiSE System training program, in alignment with the global educational strategy.
Track & Report Training Effectiveness: Maintain training metrics, certification completion rates, and trainee feedback data; prepare reporting and analysis that drive measurable improvements in learning outcomes and support audit and quality reviews.
Oversee Certification Administration for New Personnel: Manage the administrative process for onboarding and certifying new field operations personnel, Field Clinical Specialists (FCSs), and sales representatives, including tracking knowledge and skills assessments through to certification or remediation.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with clinical, marketing, sales, regulatory, and quality teams to ensure consistent messaging, accurate product positioning, and the integration of new product launches into training initiatives. Act as a liaison between field teams, physician customers, and internal stakeholders to optimize training processes.

Other Responsibilities

Mentor and provide guidance to Field Clinical Specialists and other training personnel to enhance technical and clinical competencies needed to support training activities.
Support Training & Education leadership in building scalable learning platforms, including LMS enhancements and digital training content.
Collaborate with medical affairs, regulatory, and quality teams to ensure training content and documentation comply with FDA and other relevant regulations.
Assist in planning and executing off-site physician education programs, hands-on cadaver labs, and key opinion leader (KOL) training events.
Provide field and physician insights to influence product development, clinical trial protocols, and future training strategies.
Represent the company at industry conferences, workshops, and professional education forums as needed.

Responsibilities

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

None

Qualifications

Education and Required Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, biomedical engineering, nursing, or a related field (or equivalent clinical experience).
Minimum 8 years of experience in the medical device industry, in training operations, program/process management, or a related function.
Prior experience developing training curricula, certification pathways, and structured onboarding programs.
Hands-on experience administering or building courses within a Learning Management System (LMS).
Demonstrated experience developing training content across multiple formats (e-learning, video, live/virtual sessions) and managing training documentation for audit readiness.
Familiarity with FDA-regulated training materials, documentation requirements, and industry-standard educational practices, along with the compliance landscape governed by the Sunshine Act and AdvaMed Code.
Strong project/program management, organizational, and vendor-management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Clinical or technical experience supporting implantable cardiac procedures (e.g., cath lab or EP lab), or prior work within Cardiac Rhythm Management (CRM), Structural Heart (SH), Heart Failure, and/or Electrophysiology (EP) — strongly preferred to inform accurate, clinically credible training content.

Experience supporting commercial launches of novel implantable cardiac devices.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Process & Documentation Rigor: Skilled at designing, standardizing, and maintaining audit-ready training and competency documentation within a quality system framework.
Instructional Design & LMS Administration: Ability to design, build, and manage multi-modal learning solutions, including live labs, digital learning, and LMS-driven pathways.
Program & Vendor Management: Comfortable managing budgets, calendars, and vendor relationships to deliver cost-effective, high-quality training operations.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Excellent ability to work with sales, clinical, marketing, regulatory, and R&D teams to align training programs with business objectives.
Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication, presentation, and facilitation abilities.
Analytical Mindset: Comfortable developing training metrics and performance analytics to optimize program effectiveness.
Clinical/Technical Acumen (Preferred): Working understanding of cardiac pacing, intracardiac imaging, implant procedures, and cardiac device therapy strategies is a strong plus.
Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving priorities and new technology launches.

Physical Requirements

Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30–40% of the time, including occasional overnight travel.
Required to stand, walk, and sit; talk or hear; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects or controls; reach with hands and arms. Required to stoop, kneel, bend, crouch, and lift up to 50 pounds on occasion at training programs.
Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

Salary Range

$110,000 - $135,000*

Base pay is one part of your total compensation. The salary offered will depend on several factors, including, but not limited to your experience, knowledge, skills, location, internal equity, and market alignment. Addition compensation may include bonuses and equity, along with a comprehensive benefits package.

EBR Systems, Inc. does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. Please refrain from solicitations at this time.

About The Company

What if your work doesn’t just support innovation—what if it changes lives?

We don’t just create game-changing medical devices—we grow people. Patients come first in everything we do. You will be empowered to solve real problems and to do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

If you are driven by purpose, excited by challenge, and ready to shape the future of cardiac technology, we want to hear from you. Visit us at https://www.ebrsystemsinc.com/ to learn more—and join us in our work Empowering Physicians, Powering Hearts.

EBR Systems, Inc. offers a great place to work as well as generous benefits and growth opportunities:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance provided at no cost for employee-only coverage
401(k) matching plan
Paid Time Off – starting at 3 weeks per year
Competitive salary with opportunities for career growth
Employee stock options
Life & AD&D and long-term disability insurance
Education assistance
Voluntary commuter benefits and pet insurance
Weekly company lunches and occasional happy hour events for onsite employees
Meaningful work and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer Veterans/Disabled

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The Ads Product Marketing Strategy & Ops team is a key partner to Ads Product Marketing (PMM). We sit at the center of how Ads Product Marketing shapes and goes to market with new solutions. We connect the field to the roadmap, turning seller insights into action and ensuring our go-to-market strategies reflect what advertisers and customers actually need

As the Inbound Program Manager, you will build and run the systems that capture, synthesize, and activate field intelligence across Ads Product Marketing. You'll design the programs and processes that transform fragmented seller and customer feedback into structured inputs that shape product strategy, messaging, and enablement priorities.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, and other Strategy and Ops functions to build listening programs, run recurring feedback loops, and enable Ads PMM to synthesize the insights that help our teams build better products and go to market with more relevance. Your work will ensure that sellers and advertisers have a clear, reliable channel to influence what we build.

What You’ll Do

Own the Voice of Sales program end-to-end — design and run structured mechanisms that continuously collect, tag, and synthesize insights from Sales and customer-facing teams.
Build and manage Voice of Customer infrastructure — establish repeatable processes for capturing advertiser and customer signals and route them to the right PMM and Product stakeholders.
Facilitate the translation of field and customer insights into actionable outputs — oversee recurring reporting and synthesis that make it easy for PMMs and PMs to act on what they're hearing.
Close the feedback loop with Sales — ensure Sales teams receive timely, transparent updates on how their input is influencing roadmap decisions, messaging priorities, and enablement resources.
Design and build internal tools that scale how we capture, organize, and distribute insights — including AI-assisted workflows, structured intake forms, tagging systems, dashboards, and knowledge bases that reduce manual lift and increase signal quality.

What We’re Looking For

8+ years of experience in program management, product marketing operations, or a related role — ideally in a product-led or go-to-market environment.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration , or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience building or running structured feedback and listening programs (e.g., Voice of Customer, Voice of Sales, win/loss, field advisory programs) — including owning the full cycle from intake to insight delivery.
Proven ability to design and build internal tools and workflows — including AI-assisted systems, structured intake and tagging frameworks, dashboards, and knowledge bases that scale cross-functional insight sharing.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across Product Marketing, Product, and Sales teams to drive alignment and influence roadmap and GTM decisions.
Excellent synthesis and communication skills — you can take qualitative and quantitative field input and turn it into clear, compelling narratives and reports for different audiences, from ICs to leadership.
Experience creating and managing recurring reporting programs.
Highly organized and proactive, with a track record of building scalable processes and sources of truth in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

new_jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The mission is personal. The systems protected deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. The organization is the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.

About the Role

The company is seeking a Staff Business Operations Project Manager to join the Business Operations & Technology (BOT) team. This role owns day-to-day execution of senior-level operational projects that keep the organization running — spanning hardware and logistics, lab and infrastructure readiness, procurement and vendor management, and cross-departmental initiatives across IT, Security, Facilities, and Product & Engineering.

The Staff Business Operations Project Manager will work with limited direction, delivering high-complexity projects with meaningful business and financial impact. This individual will maintain comprehensive project plans and forecasts, manage risk across a varied operational portfolio, and give leadership consistent visibility into the status of various initiatives for cross-departmental efforts tied to the organization’s growth, including possible M&A-related integration work. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between strategic planning and hands-on execution, and thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Key Responsibilities

Own execution of complex, senior-level operational projects spanning hardware and logistics, infrastructure readiness, procurement, vendor management, internal software migrations, and various strategic initiatives. Flexibility and willingness to work in ambiguity are required. Must be hands-on and able to drive and own execution, not just provide direction.
Aid in project management of global logistics operations, including international shipments, trade compliance, and lifecycle tracking for hardware deployed in the field, minimizing loss and improving asset recovery.
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, roadmaps, and forecasts that reflect milestones and dependencies across the Business Operations portfolio. Enjoy working in a multi-disciplinary role across Product/Engineer/Operations.
Own sprint tracking and Agile ceremonies for active operational workstreams, ensuring consistent cadence and team accountability.
Lead issue resolution, change control, and risk mitigation independently, escalating only where cross-organizational alignment is required.
Build and maintain financial tracking, budget forecasts, and resource allocation reporting for large-scale operational initiatives.
Provide coaching and mentorship to associate and junior project managers supporting the operations portfolio.
Ensure project governance through consistent reporting, metrics, and adherence to PMO standards and policies.
Reduce single-point-of-failure risk by distributing execution responsibilities, managing risk, and maintaining clear, current status reporting and stakeholder visibility.

This role is execution-focused: you'll pull together metrics, coordinate communications, support staffing and planning processes, help track budget, and assist with audits — with a strong emphasis on making life easier for the org's Engineering Managers, Sr Directors, and VPs/Sr.VP.

This is an excellent role for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and energized by being the person who makes leaders' jobs easier — surfacing the right information at the right time, keeping processes on track, and quietly ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Team Metrics & KPIs
Pull, clean, and maintain data feeding the engineering org's KPI dashboards, flagging anomalies to the Director before they reach leadership.
Prepare metrics summaries and slide decks for Engineering Managers and Directors ahead of leadership reviews.
Support leaders in interpreting their team's metrics and preparing talking points for their own reports.
Help maintain documentation on metric definitions so the org stays consistent as it scales.
Department Communications
Draft and schedule regular department communications (newsletters, Slack updates, all-hands recap notes) for Director/VP review and approval.
Help engineering leaders prepare talking points, FAQs, and messaging for team meetings and org changes.
Maintain the engineering communications calendar and documentation hub, ensuring content stays current and easy to find.
Track feedback and questions from the org following major announcements and route them to the right leader.
Staffing & Career Development
Maintain the headcount and requisition tracker, keeping Engineering Managers updated on where their open roles stand.
Coordinate scheduling and logistics for performance review cycles, calibration sessions, and promotion committees.
Support leaders by preparing calibration materials, leveling guide references, and career development templates.
Support Associate Engineer Program, working with Mentors/Managers and HR as needed.
Assist with onboarding logistics for new engineering hires, ensuring managers have what they need on day one.
Budgeting
Track budget line items and monthly actuals, preparing variance summaries for the Director and team leaders.
Assist Engineering Managers with budget requests (tooling, travel, offsites) and route approvals.
Maintain organized records of vendor contracts, license renewals, and spend for easy leader reference.
Quarterly Planning
Coordinate logistics for the quarterly planning process: timelines, templates, reminders, and dependency tracking across teams.
Support Engineering Managers and Directors in drafting and refining their team's quarterly goals/OKRs.
Track progress against quarterly commitments and prepare status summaries for leadership check-ins.
Help run and document planning retrospectives.
Audits
Support the Director in coordinating audit logistics — scheduling reviews, collecting documentation, and following up with teams on action items.
Help leaders understand and complete audit-related requests (Airtable allocations, Audit proof, RTE Certifications) with minimal disruption to their teams.
Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and trackers.
Assist in tracking remediation items to closure.

Supervisory Responsibilities

No

Qualifications Expected For Position

2–4 years of experience in a business operations, program coordination, finance/audit, HR operations, or engineering operations role.
Strong organizational skills with experience managing multiple concurrent workstreams and deadlines.
Comfort working with data — basic proficiency in spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) and dashboard tools (Allstacks, Tableau, or similar) is expected.
Strong written communication skills; comfortable drafting content for review by senior leaders.
A service mindset: genuinely enjoys supporting others and making leaders' jobs easier.

Qualifications Preferred

Hands-on experience with Apptio and Jira.

Agency Mission

MTA Construction & Development (C&D) is responsible for the planning, development, and execution of all capital construction projects across the MTA region. Through centralized oversight and management of the MTA's $64 billion Capital Program, C&D ensures the efficient delivery of critical infrastructure projects that support the region's vast transportation network. As part of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, the largest transportation network in North America, C&D plays a key role in modernizing and expanding services that support 15.3 million residents across New York City, Long Island, southeastern New York State, and Connecticut. C&D is committed to delivering safe, innovative, and cost-effective capital projects that enhance the customer experience and strengthen the reliability and resilience of the MTA system.

Telework

This position is eligible for telework, which is currently one day per week. New hires are eligible to apply 30 days after their effective date of hire.

Job Summary

The Assistant Project Manager manages capital project delivery within the MNR business unit in the MTA Construction Development (C&D) Delivery Department. This position is part of the project management team responsible for ensuring that project delivery is safe, efficient, on schedule, within budget, and according to project documents, contractual requirements, and relevant policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.

The Assistant Project Manager monitors project status and identifies project risks and issues. This position assists the Project Manager with management, coordination, field oversight, and inspection of capital projects. This position coordinates daily project delivery activities with C&D staff, contractors, consultants, and agency forces to support the safe and efficient execution of capital projects.

Responsibilities

The Assistant Project Manager is responsible for successfully managing and mentoring staff to deliver complex capital projects.

Coordinate project activities through project close-out.

Monitor project performance against established baselines and pursue opportunities for improved performance.

Identify project issues and risks and ensure timely resolution and mitigation.

Recommend solutions to senior management for the resolution of critical issues.

Manage project activities to minimize the impact on agency operations and the public.

Coordinate project activities with the project team, C&D staff, contractors, consultants, MTA operating agency staff, and other stakeholders.

Coordinate with MTA operating agency staff to ensure necessary actions, approvals, and resources are in place to support project delivery.

Ensure project activities follow established requirements and adhere to all relevant standards, guidelines, codes, regulations, policies, and procedures.

Ensure that safety and quality are an integral part of project operations.

Manage the preparation and monitor implementation of project plans, quality plans, and work plans.

Coordinate with Safety and Quality Management staff.

Manage project documentation to ensure quality, completeness, and accuracy.

Manage and monitor progress against project scope, schedule, and budget.

Work collaboratively with Development and Contracts throughout the project life-cycle, including developing project scope, requirements, design criteria, and procurement packages, evaluating bids/proposals, negotiating change orders, and timely completing the contractor/consultant evaluation process.

Review and approve contract invoices and other project charges based on established procedures.

Ensure that expenditures are correctly charged.

Manage comprehensive project document control and retention.

Manage the preparation of reports, presentations, research, and studies.

Manage the presentation of project reporting and coordination of audit/inquiry responses for MTA and external oversight bodies.

Manage staff selection, coaching, training, development, evaluation, and discipline/termination as needed.

Create a professional environment that respects individual differences and enables all employees to develop and contribute to their full potential.

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction or Project Management, Business Administration, Transportation, or a related field.

Must have a minimum of (3) years of related experience.

A Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) / Engineer-In-Training (EIT) certificate is desirable.

A licensed Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) is desirable.

PMP and CCM Certifications are preferred.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Proficient computer skills (i.e., Windows environment, Microsoft Office, PeopleSoft, Oracle, etc.) and strong business administrative skills (i.e., presentations, report and letter writing, time management, etc.).

Comprehensive Benefits & Total Rewards Package

Transportation & Financial Benefits

Commuting Made Easy – Enjoy a complimentary MTA transportation pass, plus access to tax-advantaged commuter benefits to maximize your savings.

Premium Health Coverage at Low Cost – Access high-quality individual, family, and domestic partner healthcare, dental, vision, and life insurance plans.

Secure Your Future – Build long-term financial security through pension plans and retirement savings accounts designed for eligible employees.

Time Off & Work-Life Balance

Generous Time Away – Recharge with substantial paid time off and comprehensive holiday schedules that support your personal and family commitments.

Holistic Support Services – Access our dedicated Work Life Services team and Office of the Chaplains unit for personal guidance and support when you need it most.

Professional Growth & Development

Learning & Development Program – Advance your career through structured professional development opportunities, skills training, and leadership programs tailored to support your growth within the organization.

Educational Investment – Pursue your career goals with in-house training and professional development, tuition reimbursement support, and partnerships with educational institutions.

Employee Experience & Community

Employee Assistance Programs – Comprehensive support services to help you navigate life's challenges with confidence and resources.

Discounts & Perks – Take advantage of MTA employee discount programs offering savings on products and services.

Connect & Belong – Join our vibrant Employee Resource Groups to build meaningful connections, share experiences, and contribute to an inclusive workplace culture.

For Internal Applicants: Log in to the My MTA Portal, click on the My Job Search tile, select the Careers link, search for the desired position, click Apply, and follow the on-screen instructions.

For External Applicants: Visit www.mta.info, click the “Careers” link located in the footer under the "The MTA" section, then click on “See All Open MTA Positions”. Search for the desired position, click Apply, and follow the instructions.

Additional Information

Final salary is determined by experience, skill set, and alignment with compensation practices. The posted range reflects expected compensation and may be updated as market or business needs evolve.

To be eligible for consideration for a new role, current MTA employees must complete at least one year of service in their current role prior to applying. Additionally, eligibility to interview is contingent upon maintaining a satisfactory record of job performance, attendance, and disciplinary conduct.

Pursuant to the New York State Public Officers Law & the MTA Code of Ethics, all employees who hold a policymaking position must file an Annual Statement of Financial Disclosure (FDS) with the NYS Commission on Ethics and Lobbying in Government (the “Commission”).

Equal Employment Opportunity

MTA and its subsidiary and affiliated agencies are equal opportunity employers, including those with respect to veteran status and individuals with disabilities.

The MTA encourages qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, including military service members, to apply.

new_jobs.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

Carrier is the leading global provider of healthy, safe and sustainable building and cold chain solutions with a world-class, diverse workforce with business segments covering HVAC, refrigeration, and fire and security. We make modern life possible by delivering safer, smarter and more sustainable services that make a difference to people and our planet while revolutionizing industry trends. This is why we come to work every day. Join us and we can make a difference together.

About This Role

The National Operations Program Manager is a critical role supporting scalable national growth, operational consistency, and execution discipline across ALC Field Operations. This position strengthens how branch operations are documented, governed, adopted, and continuously improved while ensuring new field and operational employees are properly onboarded, provisioned, trained, and ready to deliver safe, high-quality customer outcomes from day one.

The National Operations Program Manager is responsible for developing, managing, publishing, and continuously improving standardized operational products, workflows, onboarding processes, and branch standard work across ALC Field Operations. This role owns the lifecycle of national operating standards, including intake, drafting, review, approval, publishing, revision control, adoption support, and retirement of outdated materials.

The position also serves as a central coordination point for operational readiness, new employee onboarding, provisioning, digital access, safety compliance, Carrier Excellence committees, and cross-functional process governance. The role translates field operations needs into clear, repeatable, measurable work instructions and scalable workflows that improve execution accuracy, reduce risk, support training, and create consistency across national branch operations.

Key Responsibilities

National Operations Standard Work and Product Management

Own the end-to-end lifecycle of branch operations standard work instructions, including intake, drafting, review, approval, publishing, revision control, adoption support, and retirement.
Partner with subject matter experts, branch leaders, and national support teams to translate operational processes into clear work instructions, job aids, checklists, workflow maps, and governance tools.
Establish documentation standards, templates, naming conventions, approval workflows, revision history practices, and publishing requirements to ensure consistency across all branches.
Maintain a centralized repository for standards, tools, and operating procedures so documents remain current, easy to find, aligned to policy, and usable by field teams.

Onboarding, Provisioning, and Operational Readiness

Develop, standardize, manage, and continuously improve national onboarding and operational readiness processes for New Install Operations and branch personnel.
Coordinate employee provisioning activities, including PPE, tools, equipment, vehicles, technology hardware, mobile devices, uniforms, access credentials, security clearances, company credit cards, and local office onboarding requirements.
Ensure new employees are trained, credentialed, provisioned, and operationally ready before deployment to projects, customer sites, and field assignments.
Track 30-60-90 day onboarding progress and report readiness status, blockers, and areas of concern to operations leadership.

Digital Systems, Workflow Enablement, and Toolchain Access

Partner with Carrier Digital and IT teams to ensure timely provisioning, setup, access validation, permissions, cybersecurity compliance, and standardization across operational platforms.
Design and manage operational workflows that improve handoffs, increase activity accuracy, reduce risk, and identify time- and cost-saving opportunities.
Support workflow automation, digital integration, SharePoint publishing, and process visibility improvements across national operations.
Safety, Compliance, Training, and Change Enablement.
Coordinate required safety onboarding, certification tracking, compliance documentation, and readiness validation in partnership with Safety leadership.
Develop rollout plans for process updates, including communications, training enablement, pilot plans, go-live readiness, and post-implementation feedback loops.
Partner with training and L&D resources to ensure standard work and operational process changes are reflected in onboarding materials, job aids, and branch enablement content.

Cross-Functional Operational Coordination

Drive alignment and accountability across National Operations, Regional Operations, branch leadership, Purchasing, HR, Talent Acquisition, Fleet, Safety, Carrier Digital, training, and quality teams.
Facilitate issue resolution and escalation management for onboarding delays, process gaps, adoption challenges, documentation needs, or operational readiness blockers.
Support national operations initiatives as assigned, including special projects, process enhancements, system improvements, and cross-branch standardization efforts.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Construction Management, Engineering or Technical Writing.
3+ years of experience in operations, field operations, project management, product or program management, process improvement, quality, documentation management, or operational governance.
1+ years of experience with the Microsoft Office Suite
Clean and valid driver’s license
This position is remote but requires up to 30% travel.

Preferred Qualifications

Other qualifications you may have that would be beneficial in this role include:

Experience supporting multi-site, branch-based, field services, construction, or national operations organizations.
Experience creating, maintaining, and governing SOPs, standard work instructions, job aids, checklists, workflows, or operational playbooks.
Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, organizational planning, and cross-functional coordination skills.
Excellent written communication and technical writing skills with the ability to translate complex operational processes into clear, concise, repeatable instructions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and process workstreams in a fast-paced national operations environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, SharePoint document management, workflow systems, collaboration platforms, and operational software tools.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in commercial construction, building automation, HVAC controls, technical field services, transportation, logistics, or a regulated operational environment.
Experience with onboarding systems, workflow automation, provisioning processes, safety certification tracking, compliance management, or operational readiness programs.
Experience establishing governance forums, committees, change control processes, or cross-functional operating councils.
Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, process mapping, or root-cause analysis experience.
Experience developing training enablement materials and partnering with training or learning and development teams.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate.

Other Compensation

The company supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in-office. It operates as a digital-first organization with strong collaboration across different regions. Role

to build and scale learning initiatives.

The role will own learning across the employee lifecycle - from onboarding and fraud education through to manager development, leadership capability, performance enablement, and knowledge sharing. Design, build, and continuously improve learning programs across the employee lifecycle, including company onboarding, department onboarding, fraud education, manager development, leadership development, and ongoing professional growth.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Director, Project Management Office (PMO), the Project Delivery Manager leads the execution and delivery of Bluberi’s R&D gaming product portfolio and oversees Project Managers within the Project Delivery team. This role provides leadership, coaching and direction, governance oversight, and serves as a primary escalation point to provide support while maintaining visibility into portfolio health, resource capacity, delivery risks and organizational priorities. In this role, a key responsibility is to drive consistency in execution, compliance, reporting and performance across assigned R&D initiatives.

Working with Product Management, Game Studios, Engineering, QA, Compliance, Manufacturing, Commercial teams and executive leadership, the Project Delivery Manager supports the R&D delivery lifecycle from ideation to sunset, including development, certification, commercialization and sustainment, while contributing to PMO effectiveness and delivery maturity.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

R&D Portfolio and Delivery Management

Oversee delivery of the R&D gaming product portfolio across concurrent initiatives and product lines.
Monitor project health, milestones, delivery performance, resource use, and portfolio risks.
Identify cross-project dependencies, resource conflicts, and execution constraints.
Drive mitigation plans and executive escalations for critical delivery issues.
Support portfolio planning, prioritization, and capacity management activities.
Maintain visibility into portfolio status and delivery forecasts for leadership.
Align strategic objectives, project priorities, and available organizational capacity.

Lead, coach, mentor and develop Project Managers within the Project Delivery team.

Promote consistent project management methods, governance practices, tools, and reporting standards.
Review project execution quality, health, and adherence to PMO standards.
Support workload balancing and resource allocation across the PM team.
Foster accountability, transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Build project management capability within the team through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing.

Support Project Managers in resolving escalated delivery issues and aligning stakeholders throughout execution.
Ensure projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned with organizational objectives.

Governance and Lifecycle Management

Ensure projects follow lifecycle phases, governance reviews, stage-gate approvals, and readiness assessments.
Facilitate governance forums while functional teams retain ownership of deliverables, approvals, and business decisions.
Monitor compliance with PMO standards and operational best practices.
Promote consistency, predictability, transparency, and continuous improvement across project execution.

Executive Reporting and Stakeholder Management

Deliver executive-level R&D portfolio reporting, forecasts, strategic updates, recommendations, and mitigation plans.
Align priorities and delivery commitments with Product Management, Engineering, Compliance, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Operations leaders.
Serve as the primary escalation point for R&D delivery conflicts and cross-functional challenges.
Facilitate executive reviews, steering committees, governance forums, and key leadership decisions.

Risk, Issue and Change Management

Oversee portfolio-level risk, issue, assumption, and dependency management activities.
Ensure appropriate mitigation plans are established and executed.
Facilitate key project and product decisions through stakeholder alignment, documenting rationale, approval tracking, and decision traceability.
Support organizational change initiatives and implementation activities.
Escalate critical risks and delivery concerns with clear recommendations and recovery plans.

Support execution across key product lifecycle phases including:
Ideation and opportunity assessment
Product planning and roadmap execution
Game design and mathematics development
Software and hardware development
Testing and certification
Regulatory submission and approvals
Manufacturing readiness
Commercial launch and deployment
Product sustainment
Product retirement and sunset

Coordinate dependencies across game content, hardware platforms, operating systems, peripherals, and customer requirements.
Support sustainment and sunset initiatives through retirement planning, operational transitions, readiness activities, and lifecycle closure governance.

Drive adoption of PMO standards, metrics, templates, and best practices within the Project Delivery team.
Support implementation and optimization of portfolio management tools and reporting solutions.
Develop delivery KPIs, R&D portfolio metrics, and performance measurements.
Improve organizational visibility into capacity, priorities, project health, and delivery performance.
Lead delivery-focused improvement initiatives that enhance team effectiveness and PMO maturity.

Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
8+ years project, program, or portfolio management experience in a technology, gaming, software, hardware, manufacturing, or product development environment.
3+ years experience leading, mentoring, coaching, or supervising Project Managers or cross-functional delivery teams.
Demonstrated success managing large-scale, complex, cross-functional initiatives from ideation through delivery.
Experience overseeing multiple concurrent projects while balancing portfolio priorities, resources, risks, and delivery commitments.
Experience working within a PMO environment with formal governance and portfolio management processes.
Strong knowledge of project, program, and portfolio management methodologies including Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery approaches.
Experience leading executive reviews, steering committees, escalation management, and cross-functional decision-making processes.

Experience managing schedules, dependencies, risks, budgets, resource planning, and executive reporting.
Excellent communication, leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
Proven ability to develop teams, drive accountability, and improve organizational execution.

Experience in the casino gaming, entertainment technology, or regulated gaming industry.
Experience leading Project Managers or PM organizations responsible for hardware and software product development.
PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Certified Scrum Master, or equivalent PM certification.
Experience establishing or maturing PMO governance frameworks, portfolio and lifecycle management processes, supporting Stage-Gate, NPDI, PLM, commercialization initiatives.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, Monday.com, ServiceNow, Power BI.
Experience working with globally distributed engineering and product organizations.
Understanding of gaming regulations, certification processes, market requirements, manufacturing readiness, and commercialization activities.

Leadership

Develops people, builds accountability and enables high-performing teams.
Creates clarity, alignment, and execution focus across complex organizations.

Strategic Execution, Operational Excellence And Problem Solving

Balances long-term objectives with short-term delivery commitments.
Drives portfolio performance through data-driven decision making.
Improves processes, governance maturity, delivery predictability, and organizational effectiveness.
Anticipates challenges, proactively develops practical solutions, and effectively resolves organizational and cross-functional obstacles.

Other relevant professional certifications.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Solutions
new_jobs.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About The Role

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Planet, you will drive Planet’s largest, complex efforts that cross many teams and organizational boundaries. You will focus on execution of programs through the product life cycle. You will work closely with team leads to develop and manage end to end program plans. This includes establishing and managing internal processes, schedules, metrics, risks, and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You will work with both technical and non-technical teams.

We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to support solutions development for Defense and Intelligence. You will be the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and our customers, turning big-picture roadmaps into structured execution plans and accountable timelines. From managing custom customer deployments to supporting the engineering release train, you’ll cut through ambiguity, manage cross-functional dependencies, and proactively mitigate risk to ensure seamless delivery.

This is a full-time, hybrid role which will require you to work from our Washington, DC or Denver, CO office 3 days per week.

Impact You'll Own

Orchestrate end-to-end program execution across Engineering, Product, Design, Space Systems, Enablement, and Customer Support to ensure successful releases.
Scope comprehensive program schedules and break down complex requirements into actionable, incremental milestones.
Translate requirements across business and technical stakeholders with communication clarity.
Identify dependencies and risks and proactively mitigate them.
Facilitate decision making through data-driven analysis and healthy debate.
Communicate vertically & horizontally across Planet to keep stakeholders informed of progress, priorities, risks, and changes to requirements or plans.
Drive for results by continuously improving ways of working and processes, now and for the future.

What You Bring

4+ years of software development or program management experience in the areas of SaaS, platform development, or analytics.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
Experience working with cross-functional teams across a broad organization.
Thrives in ambiguous environments, with a track record of designing and implementing scalable processes and frameworks from scratch.
Experience with the product life cycle: concept through development, launch preparation, go-to-market, deprecations, and end-of-life.
Analytical, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills paired with the ability to communicate findings and recommendations.
Equally comfortable explaining your analyses and recommendations to business leaders as you are discussing technical trade-offs with engineers.
Ability to balance the tactical day-to-day with forward-looking improvements to scale operational efficiencies.

What Makes You Stand Out

A desire to improve processes, tools, and ways of working to scale operations cycles.
Experience with remote sensing, earth observation data, or geospatial systems.
Experience working with remote, worldwide teams.
A growth mindset and a desire to learn quickly.
Actively exploring AI technologies to automate workflows, improve data, or enhance team productivity.

Application Deadline

October 22, 2026 by 11:59p / 23:59 CET (Central European Time)

This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.

Benefits While Working At Planet

Why We Care So Much About Belonging.

We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work. If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!
